status: IMPLEMENTED; LOCAL REHEARSAL PROOF AND FRESH CLOUD BINDINGS REQUIRED; NO N640 EXECUTED

configuration.initial_condition: Original analytic legacy tubes: gamma=5, a=.25, sep=.6, pert=.35; same audited projection, no N512 restart
configuration.target_t_interpretation: 1.5 is an optional ceiling, never a required completed trajectory

spatial_acceptance.actual_end: minimum of both last accepted diagnostic times
primary_curve_metrics: max matched net-production difference scaled by production-plus-loss
spatial_acceptance.net_curve_difference: absolute difference divided by maximum of both production-plus-viscous-loss magnitudes and 1e-14
secondary_metrics: grid wmax and grid-based BKM, both sampling-sensitive
spatial_acceptance.intermediate_band: greater than 0.001 and less than 0.01: inconclusive sensitivity
spatial_acceptance.interpretation: Consistency of sampled observables on two discretizations, not proof of resolution or convergence order.
spatial_acceptance.beyond_common_window: single-grid exploratory observations only; no N512/N640 convergence claim

grid_sampled_wmax.role: secondary sensitivity screen, not primary acceptance
measures: sampled time reported without a timing gate
grid_sampled_wmax.explanation: Different grids sample different positions. No retrospective spectral interpolation of the N512 t=0.89 maximum is possible from the retained endpoint fields.
grid_sampled_wmax.borderline_interpretation: Sampling-inconclusive secondary screen; neither crossing 1% nor the retained N512 endpoint biases alone establishes discretization sensitivity. Integral curves and stable matched Fourier peak estimates determine their separately recorded primary classifications.

fitted_net_peak.role: supplementary only, never a protected-validation gate
fitted_net_peak.search_domain: each grid own accepted observed interval, separately labelled; no failing samples
fitted_net_peak.required_bracket: five uniform events centered on sampled maximum, with both sides accepted; also fit central three
fitted_net_peak.fitted_quantity: local quadratic vertex time and value
fitted_net_peak.uncertainty: Report 3/5-point fit sensitivity, half-event spacing, residual/curvature scale; not a statistical confidence interval or rigorous bound.
fitted_net_peak.classification: within declared tolerances, separated estimates, or inconclusive after sensitivity envelopes
fitted_net_peak.outside_common_interval: Supplementary comparison of separately observed local peaks only. Does not extend N512 validated trajectory, establish a global maximum, or certify later N640 temporal error.
fitted_net_peak.if_unbracketed: inconclusive, not failure of protected curve result

spatial_acceptance.primary_interpretation: 0.1% agreement of integral Z and scaled net-production curves on the common accepted interval. Percent-level discrepancy indicates discretization sensitivity; grid-maximum sampling does not control this label.

matched_fourier_wmax.role: primary matched local-peak observable, conditional on estimator stability on both grids

method.name: separable Fourier local search
method.scope: local peak estimate; seed and search sensitivity are not rigorous error bounds

matched_fourier_wmax.qualification: Fourier local peak estimate, not certified global supremum. Unstable estimates are explicitly inconclusive.
matched_fourier_wmax.historical_t0p89: No full N512 field; sampled maximum remains secondary.

notes: Finite diagnostics and exact matched output times are mandatory.
Tail cutoff is a heuristic; passing smoke does not establish high-Re grid convergence.
N32 reference is backend equivalence only; do not use its tail to certify spatial resolution.
Energy FD residual is interval-quadrature consistency, separate from instantaneous RHS identity.
Float64 smoke state is required: local float32 SSPRK3 TGV failed the 1% interval dissipation gate; the gate was retained.
Thresholds are fixed before H100 data; changes require a new recorded plan and review.

spectral_diagnostics.note: Record lower/center/upper rounded-shell k^4 loss fractions for fixed k>=128 and N640 outer quarter k>=160 at every event. Compare N512 outer-quarter k>=128 separately.
spectral_diagnostics.interpretation: Dissipation shares are calibration diagnostics. No new share-based pass threshold is chosen after looking at N640.

temporal_validation.anchor: fixed N640 coarse checkpoint at t=1.00
temporal_validation.scope: Local continuation from the same N640 checkpoint; inherited time error is common. This does not certify accumulated N640 error at earlier peaks.
temporal_validation.if_unavailable: planned protected validation incomplete; preserve evidence and do not explore
temporal_validation.execution_phase: immediately after coarse prefix reaches 1.10, before exploration
temporal_validation.resume_exploration: load coarse t=1.10 checkpoint in a new process after fine process exits
temporal_validation.beyond_1p1: No additional temporal certification; optional exploration only.

checkpoint_collection.arrays_to_collect: one N640 coarse t=1.10 protected checkpoint, if measured transfer forecast fits
checkpoint_collection.final_metadata_rule: archive exact checkpoint.json for every checkpoint before deleting any arrays; retain all per-component SHA256 values
checkpoint_collection.failing_terminal: diagnostics, spectra and exact metadata/hashes retained; arrays excluded from collection
checkpoint_collection.prune_rule: only new campaign fields; after successful fine-window validation and metadata archive; preserve prior campaign arrays
checkpoint_collection.collection: lossless gzip level 1, verified SHA256 of decompressed files, all diagnostic/config/timing files first
checkpoint_collection.checkpoint_time_note: The protected checkpoint is exactly t=1.10; exploratory fields have separate metadata/hash records.
checkpoint_collection.protected_small_artifacts: all prefix/fine diagnostics, full spectra, configs, source/runtime/timing/GPU records, checkpoint metadata/hash history, assessment; verified in WSL before exploration
checkpoint_collection.optional_checkpoint_priority: After verified small evidence; overlap pinned field download with exploration only when measured joint lifetime forecast passes.
checkpoint_collection.memory_rule: Separate coarse/fine/exploration processes. Wait for process exit before the next load; do not retain two full trajectories on GPU.

overlap.transfer_allowance: 1.5*(actual compressed bytes/slowest probe + compression time + max(60s,2*remote verification time))
overlap.fallback: sequential collection and shortened/skipped exploration; protected snapshot stays immutable
overlap.pin: fixed coarse t=1.10 gzip archive; exploration writes a separate directory

budget.transfer_quote_rule: Include 8.25 GB upper egress including probes and small snapshots, image/environment ingress, residual storage and fees within USD 0.50; otherwise refuse/reprice.
budget.provider_guard_deadline: 60s before financial lifetime bound; 120s normal cleanup reserve. API outages can prevent timely destruction; guard retries and retains financial commitment until verified absence.
budget.hourly_gate_interpretation: Offer screening ceiling only; measured protected-phase runtime must fit remaining lifetime after 60s guard advance and 120s cleanup reserve. Optional exploration is never required.

preflight.runtime_gate: Required prefix+fine+verified small-artifact collection must fit actual remaining lifetime with 25% compute margin. Optional checkpoint and exploration get independent forecasts from remaining time; 1.5 completion is not required.
preflight.CFL_rule: Forecast using actual achieved dt; abort production forecast when clipping increases projected steps beyond available time.

same_host_N512_benchmark.measure: synchronized integration window separate from diagnostics, init and checkpoint costs
same_host_N512_benchmark.baseline_reference: 0.5997 seconds ordinary-step median is directly comparable; 0.43635 historical total/step includes diagnostics and is context, not identical timing.
same_host_N512_benchmark.limitation: Measures this host performance; does not uniquely identify the historical slowdown cause.
same_host_N512_benchmark.execution: separate process exits before N640 preflight; no simultaneous solver states

transfer_probe.transport: actual provider SSH/SCP endpoint and planned stream strategy
transfer_probe.measure: end-to-end including handshake; retain actual bytes, wall time, checksum, ingress/egress quote
transfer_probe.throughput_floor: minimum measured trial; do not use advertised bandwidth
transfer_probe.compression_measurement: time gzip -1 and SHA verification on the actual N640 preflight checkpoint; record compressed bytes
transfer_probe.runtime_allowance: 1.5 times measured transfer+compression+verification, plus cleanup; raw 6.311 GB is fallback upper only, not assumed completed in 600 seconds

preflight.baseline_speed_and_FFT_scaling: N^3 log N adds factor log(640)/log(512)=1.03577 to pure cubic FFT scaling. 640=2^7*5 is an optimized small-prime size; hardware/plan-specific radix penalty is not known before measurement.
preflight.memory_between_phases: No overlapping solver processes. Confirm prior process exit and monitor actual driver memory during setup, diagnostics and reload.

disk_requirement.live_gate: Measure statvfs available bytes after setup and after preflight field pruning; require 1.2*(6*6311117184+6320000000+2000000000). Image occupancy is accounted by actual free bytes, not assumed.

indicative_forecasts_not_measured_N640.label: extension total per-step cubic extrapolation; intentionally includes output overhead twice conservatively

indicative_forecasts_not_measured_N640.note: 600-second setup and 180-second small-artifact reserve are scenarios, not measured commitments. Full checkpoint transfer is optional and independently forecast.

execution_note: Separate scripts/run_vast_refinement.py default plan only; explicit --execute requires matching all rehearsal cases, exact live offer, fresh billing, bootstrap and payload bindings. Earlier launchers retain original grid restrictions.
scientific_goal: Protect the original-IC comparison through 1.10 and its local temporal validation; then use remaining resources for a temporally checked checkpoint and optional accepted-horizon exploration up to 1.5.
higher_grid_scope: No N768/N1024 run proposed or authorized here.
revision: Protected-core offer screening at USD2.60/hr, measured 64GB disk model, read-only offer watch

phase_order.name: preflight
actions: actual compressed-checkpoint and incompressible transfer probes

phase_order.name: coarse_prefix
phase_order.note: Original analytic IC. Stop immediately on unchanged numerical gates. Process exits before fine-window process starts.

phase_order.name: fine_prefix_window
phase_order.note: No concurrent coarse GPU state. Compare exact matched samples with coarse prefix.

phase_order.name: protected_assessment_and_collection
actions: independently validate numerical and local temporal gates
record matched two-grid primary curve classification
copy all small evidence to WSL and verify every hash

phase_order.name: optional_checkpoint_collection
phase_order.note: Prefer securing the temporally checked state before spending residual time on exploration. Measured compression/transfer/hash forecast decides whether it fits.

phase_order.name: optional_exploration
phase_order.restart: N640 coarse t=1.10 checkpoint, not the fine-window state
phase_order.note: Only after small-artifact verification. Separate process loads one state. May shorten or skip based on actual remaining lifetime; protected status is immutable.

status_labels.protected_numerical_temporal: Requires complete accepted prefix through 1.10, the exact 1.00-1.10 fine check, and verified small artifacts in WSL.
status_labels.two_grid_consistency: Separate classification; disagreement is a useful result, not proof of a failed simulator.
status_labels.exploration: Optional and may remain incomplete without invalidating the protected record.
status_labels.checkpoint_collection: Separate collected/incomplete/skipped status; missing optional arrays never silently reported as recovered.
status_labels.early_gate_trip: Preserve accepted prefix and first failed sample; planned full comparison remains incomplete, no exploration.
status_labels.late_exploratory_gate_or_deadline: Preserve protected classification; report exploratory stop separately.

required_profiles: N256 local CUDA tubes compressed timeline
controller_rehearsal.method: independent SIGKILL of actual controller and owned process groups; partial transfers never promoted
